meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How Eurotech Auto Repair Centre collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

sections.heading: Who We Are
paragraphs: {businessName} operates from {fullAddress}. When we refer to "we", "us", or "our" in this policy, we mean {businessName}.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect personal information when you:

items: Submit a quote request or contact form on our website
Bring a vehicle in for assessment or repair

paragraphs: This typically includes your name, phone number, email address, vehicle details, and information about the damage or repair required. If your repair involves an insurance claim, we may also collect your policy number and insurer details.

items: Communicate with you about your repair
Process insurance claims on your behalf (with your consent)
Contact you about your vehicle's progress

paragraphs: We do not use your information for marketing purposes unless you have specifically opted in.

sections.heading: Who We Share It With
paragraphs: We may share your personal information with:

items: Your insurance company, to process a claim you have authorised
Parts suppliers, where necessary to complete your repair
Our form provider (Cognito Forms), which processes online form submissions on our behalf

paragraphs: We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties for their own marketing purposes.

sections.heading: How We Protect It
paragraphs: Online form submissions are processed through Cognito Forms using encrypted (HTTPS) connections. We store customer records securely and limit access to staff who need the information to carry out their work.

sections.heading: How Long We Keep It
paragraphs: We retain your information for as long as necessary to complete your repair and meet our legal obligations. Repair records are typically kept for seven years in accordance with New Zealand tax and business record requirements.

sections.heading: Your Rights
paragraphs: Under the New Zealand Privacy Act 2020, you have the right to:

items: Ask what personal information we hold about you
Request correction of any information that is wrong
Ask us to delete your information (subject to legal retention requirements)

sections.html: To make a request, contact us at {email} or phone {phone}.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be available on this page.
